newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD auction expected March 15 - BNDES.
newsitem.headline: CVRD auction expected March 15 - BNDES.

text.p: The privatization auction of Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) is expected to take place March 15, according to the superintendant of privatization at Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).

Tereza Cristina Guimaraes said the auction of an initial 40-45 percent share block in CVRD was likely to take place March 15, and the tender document with the minimum price would be published January 30.
"We are working with these dates for now, unless the National Privatization Council decides to change them at its December 17 meeting," she said.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
